Thus .limitless.toml:10 reads a missing `process.env.LIMITLESS_TEST_WORKERS` and selects its `n>0 ? n : 4` fallback.
verification.trigger: The daemon starts with LIMITLESS_TEST_WORKERS=6. Factory gate environment filtering removes the override, so the configured test gate runs with four workers.

goldSummary: Increasing panel test deadlines leaves the underlying parallel Git race undiagnosed.

finding.title: Panel flake is addressed only by increasing timeouts

verification.evidence: test/pipeline-panel.test.ts:210–212 says "Two implementation/panel rounds exceeded waitFor's 20 s deadline under git subprocess load" and changes the wait to `waitFor(f, run.id, ["succeeded", "failed", "needs_human"], 40_000)`; line 239 sets `60_000` for Bun. The handler and wait helper are otherwise unchanged from base. test/pipeline-support.ts:175 checks `while (Date.now() < deadline)` and line 189 throws `new Error(`timed out waiting for ...`)`. No code guarantees completion within 40 seconds.
verification.trigger: Parallel git subprocess contention delays the two rounds beyond 40 seconds; waitFor throws and fails the suite despite correct eventual completion. This remains plausible under the requested load, but a recurrence at the new deadline is not proven.

goldSummary: Factory gate environment construction discards the configured test worker override.

finding.title: Factory gates discard the worker-count override

verification.evidence: src/gates/run.ts:64 defines `gateEnv` using `agentEnv({ CI: "1", NO_COLOR: "1", FORCE_COLOR: "0" })`, and :79 passes that environment to execution. src/util/proc.ts:579-582 strips variables matching `...|LIMITLESS_` except invocation markers. .limitless.toml:10 reads `process.env.LIMITLESS_TEST_WORKERS` and defaults to 4. A runtime probe with the override set to 2 found it absent from gateEnv().
verification.trigger: An operator sets LIMITLESS_TEST_WORKERS=2 in the factory environment; gate environment sanitization removes it, so the test gate uses four workers and defeats the requested contention control.

finding.title: Parallel test gate can no longer provide verification evidence

verification.evidence: src/pipeline/engine.ts:1160 sets "testCommand: gateTestCommand(check.result.command, testScripts)". src/pipeline/gate-evidence.ts:16 accepts only "/^bun test(?: [\w./-]+)*$/", rejecting the command at .limitless.toml:10 containing "--parallel=$(...)". gate-evidence.ts:39 returns false when testCommand is null; lines 125–127 leave the criterion blocked when coverage cannot be established.
verification.trigger: A targeted verification command is sandbox-blocked, while the full parallel gate passes and covers its file; the gate command parses to null, preventing evidence substitution and leaving verification blocked.

goldSummary: Against an older daemon that ignores the new repo parameter, limitless_list_runs returns other repositories' runs as matches, because the proxy never checks that the filter was applied.

finding.title: Repository filtering silently fails against an older daemon

verification.evidence: src/integrations/mcp.ts:233–235 forwards repo as a query parameter: `...(repo ? { repo } : {})`. Base src/server/http.ts:402–407 reads only status, ids and limit and calls `store.listRuns({ ...(status ? { status } : {}), ...(ids?.length ? { ids } : {}), limit })`. Head src/integrations/mcp.ts:389–392 slices those results without checking repoSlug.
verification.trigger: A new MCP proxy requests a repository filter from the previous daemon version while another repository has newer runs. The daemon ignores repo, and the proxy returns unrelated runs as matching results.
